subject: POC prompt set & eval dataset - next steps and success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Lopez <s.lopez@acmehealth.com>, Daniel Price <dprice@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC prompt set & eval dataset - next steps and success criteria

Hi Sofia / Daniel - thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and the concrete next steps so we're all aligned on the POC scope and deliverables.

Summary of goals
- Validate model quality on your live prompt patterns for routing + response generation.
- Verify latency and cost envelope for the expected traffic profile.
- Produce an evaluation report and baseline run that you can use to make a go/no-go decision.

Proposed success criteria (we can iterate):
- Intent accuracy / routing correctness: <= 5% misclassification on the evaluation set.
- Response quality: weighted accept rate >= 90% across primary intents (as judged by your SME test-set).
- Latency: p95 generation latency < 350ms for typical 1-2 turn prompts (512 token budget baseline).
- Stability: no errors / timeouts in 95% of requests at your expected concurrency for the trial.

Requested from Acme Health (what we need from you)
1) Prompt set: 300-500 representative prompts (CSV preferred) capturing the range of intents and edge cases. Include an intent label column if available.
2) Optional: 1-2 weeks of anonymized API logs (headers removed or redacted for PHI) to surface distribution and rate patterns.
3) Success-owner: please confirm a single point of contact for labeling/questions (name/email).

Redwood commitments
- Provide a POC evaluation template (attached) and a short eval plan within 3 business days of receiving the prompt set/logs.
- Run baseline against two model variants and share results + recommended config (batching, quantization tradeoffs).
- Kickoff technical session with our SE (Nikhil) to get creds / dataset access and review data hygiene.

Timeline (target)
- You share prompts + logs by EOD Thu 2026-03-05.
- Redwood delivers eval plan by Mon 2026-03-09.
- Technical kickoff and dataset handoff the week of 2026-03-09; baseline results by 2026-03-13.

Next steps / asks for you today
- Sofia/Daniel: confirm you can share ~500 prompts + anonymized logs by 2026-03-05 and who will own labeling.
- Please upload to the Drive link I'll create or send via SFTP; include a contact for creds.

Attachment: POC-eval-template.csv (simple columns for prompt, intent, expected_response, notes).

Thanks - looking forward. I'll follow up with the eval plan and a calendar invite for the kickoff.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
https://redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: POC prompt set & eval dataset - next steps and success criteria

Thanks Marissa - great summary. We can deliver a first slice of the data. A few notes and clarifications: 

What we're attaching/doing
- Attached: acme_prompts_sample.csv (500 rows, intent column included) and acme_api_logs_202602.csv (anonymized; we removed headers and user identifiers).
- We've scrubbed direct PHI from the samples but can run a more thorough scrub if you need a compliance checklist.

Success criteria tweaks
- Latency target: we want to aim for p95 < 400ms initially; if XXXX model meets 350ms that's great but we're ok with a 400ms threshold for the POC.
- Accuracy: agree on <=5% routing errors as a stoplight metric.

Security/compliance
- We cannot share raw logs with PHI. If Redwood needs closer inspection, we can provide an isolated SFTP + short-term access token and a redacted sample for the Drive share.

Availability for kickoff
- I'm available Wed 2026-03-10 09:00-11:30 PT or Thu 2026-03-11 13:00-16:00 PT. Daniel will join for the kickoff and will be the business owner.

Attaching files: acme_prompts_sample.csv, acme_api_logs_202602.csv


Sofia Lopez
Product Manager, Acme Health
sofia.lopez@acmehealth.com

Thanks Sofia - this is perfect and timely. Quick confirmations and updates: 

1) Data receipt: we have the two files in your email; I'll also create a Drive folder and share a link (see related links). If you prefer SFTP we can use that - confirm creds and we'll pull.

2) Success criteria: we'll target p95 < 350ms as an internal stretch; we'll report against the 400ms threshold for your decisioning. We'll clearly show both numbers in the baseline report.

3) Dataset size & labeling: 500 prompts is ideal - thanks. Can you confirm an internal SME (Daniel?) will review the evaluation labels if we have edge cases?

4) Next deliverables from Redwood:
- Formal POC eval plan (attached: POC-eval-plan.pdf).
- Baseline runs against two variants and a recommended config.
- Short summary deck for exec review.

5) Kickoff: booking for Wed 2026-03-10 at 09:30 PT with our SE (Nikhil) - sending invite now. Please let us know if that conflicts with your availability window.

6) Security: noted on PHI. For the evaluation we will work with redacted logs only and follow strict access rules; we can sign an IP/handling addendum if required.

Attachments: POC-eval-plan.pdf

Thanks again - assigning Nikhil to the thread for the technical handoff.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: Re: POC prompt set & eval dataset - next steps and success criteria

Hi Sofia / Daniel - thanks for the data and the invite. I'm Nikhil, SE on this POC. A few quick technical notes ahead of the kickoff: 

- Access: please provide either Drive share with edit access (preferred) or SFTP creds (user + one-time token). If you send SFTP creds, please also indicate the folder path where the logs live.
- Data hygiene: we'll run a quick parser to confirm column mapping; if you included an intent label column that will speed manual checks significantly.
- Evaluation plan: we'll run the prompt set through two model variants (redwood-opt-3b and redwood-opt-13b-int8) and produce: intent routing confusion matrix, per-intent accept-rate, latency distribution (p50/p95), and cost estimates.
- Dry run: we'll do a small dry run on a random 50-row subset during the kickoff to validate the pipeline.

Kickoff times - I'll accept the 09:30 PT Wed 2026-03-10 slot Marissa proposed and will send calendar invite with a short agenda (dataset handoff, creds check, dry run, next steps).

If you have any compliance contacts (security or legal) that need to be on the call, please add them to the invite.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
